description.narrative: Stöd till inkubator företagsetablering Stockholms Handelshögskolan och Makerere Universitet
Support to incubator entrepreneurship Stockholm Business School and Makerere University

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: GBL has established and an incubator programme in Uganda that has coached 238 companies, supported 22 of them through the acceleration programme and enabled 18 to successfully complete the GBL programme. According to the evaluation report, participation in the programme has enabled to 67% of the companies to report an expansion in their businesses. additionally, 11% of these companies more than doubled their operations after being part of the programme.
- 159 full time jobs were created by the incubation, additional 200 part-time jobs were also created specifically targeting women. 80% of women-owned companies reported having created new jobs compared to 25% for male-owned - 48% of the companies that benefitted were women-owned. - 56% of the companies incubated reported increase in revenue sales - 67% of the companies incubated also noted that through GBL's suppport, they managed to reduce their cost of doing business - 80% of the companies supported got legally registered - 14% of the companies reported to have managed to access credit (debt financing) as a result of incubation process.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
